_comment: Copy this file to env.json and fill in your values. env.json is .gitignore'd.
_max_concurrency: Total size of the shared cylinder pool across ALL projects.
_dashboard: There is ONE dashboard for all projects, on this port. The title defaults to 'Outright Mental'; override with dashboard_title.
_projects: All projects share the single cylinder pool above. Each project's max_concurrency caps how many of those shared cylinders may work it at once (it never reserves them). Caps may sum to more than the global pool; the pool is simply allocated to whichever projects have headroom, in listed order.
